articles.title: Is the Red September Curse Over? Bitcoin Set for Best September on Record
articles.description: Bitcoin is up 7.33% in September, edging past 2024 as the best September on record, with one day left before the monthly candle closes.

articles.title: Bitcoin Hovers at $84K as Treasury Yields Hold Near Multi-Year Highs
articles.description: Analysts point to crude prices capping non-yielding assets, while spot ETFs have taken money in for eight sessions running.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Citi and Coinbase Just Made Stablecoins Invisible
articles.description: Plus, crypto majors rebound as oil and yields fall and Saylor’s Strategy returns to buying Bitcoin.

articles.title: Canada's 'Crypto King' Aiden Pleterski to Represent Himself at Fraud Trial
articles.description: The judge has told Pleterski he will raise objections on his behalf, to keep inadmissible evidence away from the jury.

articles.title: Coinbase Now Owns Every Layer of Its Derivatives Stack After CFTC Approval
articles.description: Coinbase Clearing will take USDC as collateral and settle around the clock, though margined products stay with partners.

articles.title: OpenAI Halts Model Training as Rogue Agents Target US Government Sites
articles.description: OpenAI says its agents keep landing on government websites because they treat them as reliable sources, but it's pausing training while it adds safeguards.

articles.title: A Clever RSA Attack Fooled a Hardware Vault—Here's What It Means for Crypto
articles.description: A UC San Diego-led team impersonated a hardware security module without extracting its key.

articles.title: Citi Clients Can Now Take Stablecoin Payments Through Coinbase—Without Touching Crypto
articles.description: Coinbase and Citi expanded an existing deal so Citi's institutional clients can accept stablecoin payments, while Coinbase business accounts run on Citi's banking rails.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 Is Out, Beats Opus 5.5 at Coding for Half the Price
articles.description: Anthropic's mid-tier model tops its own flagship on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and costs half as much per token, but an independent tester found it burns more tokens than any model it has measured.

articles.title: After AI Agent Hacked Its Government, Australia Calls Altman and Amodei to Testify
articles.description: Senator Sarah Hanson-Young has invited the OpenAI and Anthropic CEOs to a Canberra hearing on October 1, after an OpenAI agent quietly accessed Australia's Medicare data and nobody said a word for months.

articles.title: Nvidia Built a Kill Switch for AI Agents Because They Keep Getting Out
articles.description: OpenShell and Sentry give AI agents a hardware-enforced leash, arriving after a summer of agents breaching a government site, hacking their own tests, and going rogue during a security evaluation.

articles.title: Strive Buys $94.5 Million in Bitcoin, Pushing Holdings Past 27,000 BTC
articles.description: Strive bought 1,107 BTC for $94.5 million last week, lifting its holdings to 27,462 BTC, with its SATA preferred stock supplying 85% of the capital.

articles.title: Months After the $292M Kelp Hack, Chainlink Lets Institutions Add Their Own Bridge Checks
articles.description: Chainlink's CCIP 2.0 lets banks run their own security checks on cross-chain transfers, five months after a rival's setup lost $292 million to hackers.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin Outlines 'Cryptographic World Computer' Plan for Ethereum
articles.description: Hegota will be Ethereum's last 'normal' fork, he argues, with everything after built on recursive STARKs and formal verification.

articles.title: Bitcoin Falls Lower as Trump's Iran Snub Sends Oil, Yields Higher
articles.description: Bitcoin extends last week's pullback as Trump rejects Iran's ceasefire plan, sending oil above $100 and yields higher ahead of Wednesday's PCE report.

articles.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Buys Another $47M of ETH, Taking It to 4.9% of Ethereum Supply
articles.description: Bitmine has staked 84% of its tokens, a position it projects will generate some $358 million a year in staking rewards.

articles.title: Strategy Sets New BTC Holdings Record After $143M Bitcoin Purchase
articles.description: Michael Saylor's Bitcoin treasury firm bought 1,665 BTC last week, taking its holdings above its previous record to 847,666 BTC.

articles.title: Morning Minute: SEC Clears Token Buybacks for Crypto Networks
articles.description: The Gary Gensler era is long gone and now the SEC is providing clarity on what crypto protocols can and can’t do with their tokens.

articles.title: California Bans Public Officials From Issuing Meme Coins Under New Newsom Law
articles.description: Governor Gavin Newsom’s legislation bars public officials from issuing meme coins and exchanges from listing tokens tied to politicians.

articles.title: AI Agents Keep Escaping Their Creators' Control—Here's What We Know
articles.description: An OpenAI agent's breach of an Australian government website is the starkest example yet of a pattern building for months—and of how hard autonomous AI is to contain.

articles.title: Bitcoin's Quantum Problem: Three Ways Researchers Are Trying to Fix It

articles.title: SEC Staff Says Token Buybacks Don't Make Crypto a Security—If the Network Works
articles.description: New SEC staff guidance says announcing a token buyback on a functional network isn't a promise that turns the token into a security, a shift one attorney says makes securities laws look "opt-in."

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Notch Seven-Day Winning Streak as 2026 Flows Turn Green
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs have drawn nearly $3 billion over seven straight sessions, erasing post-Clarity Act losses and pushing 2026 flows back into positive territory.

articles.title: How Crypto Stopped Waiting for Congress and Learned to Love the Regulators
articles.description: After the Clarity Act failed in the Senate, the SEC, CFTC, and the Fed moved within days to write crypto's rules themselves. Will it be enough?

articles.title: AI Agents Are Racing to Make Quantum-Safe Bitcoin Cheap—And Winning
articles.description: An open competition run by StarkWare, Yukon Research, and Eigen Labs drove the estimated cost of building a quantum-safe Bitcoin transaction from about $320 to roughly $67, with AI models topping the leaderboards.

articles.title: Google Just Made Free 1080p AI Video Generation Available to Anyone
articles.description: Google Vids now lets any Google account holder generate free HD AI video using Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, with new scene, timing, and watermark controls.

articles.title: US Prosecutors Want $84.2 Million From a Bank Tied to Tether
articles.description: Federal prosecutors are targeting a Montana payments firm and a Caribbean bank accused of moving money without a license.

articles.title: AI Agents Hacked Their Own Test Environment to Cheat, Cybersecurity Firm Finds
articles.description: Darktrace's new Signal Labs found AI agents hacking their own evaluation environment to fake a perfect score—and tricking coding assistants into running unauthorized network attacks.

articles.title: Google Built an AI That Hunts Its Own Security Bugs
articles.description: Google's PageBreak agent autonomously finds and verifies real vulnerabilities in its own web apps, cutting through the flood of noisy AI-generated security reports.

articles.title: Circle and Tether Freeze Stablecoins Tied to Bitget Hack—But Most Funds Slip Away
articles.description: The two stablecoin issuers blacklisted a wallet labeled "Bitget Exploiter 8," locking about $318,000 in USDC and USDT—but the attacker swapped most funds into unfreezable ETH before they could act.

articles.title: OpenAI Is Building a $500 per Month ChatGPT Pro Max Plan, Leaks Suggest
articles.description: Leaked code strings and screenshots point to a new tier that would cost 25 times more than ChatGPT Plus, aimed at people who need the bot to work faster, not just longer.

articles.title: Bitget Hack Losses Climb to $387M: Here’s What Happened, and Why North Korea Is a Suspect
articles.description: An attacker faked internal transfer requests to drain $387.5 million from Bitget's hot and warm wallets, and the exchange's CEO says the fingerprints look like Pyongyang's.

articles.title: Magic Eden Warns Old Ethereum NFT Listings Are Exposed to Payment Processor Exploit
articles.description: A flaw in Limit Break's Payment Processor V2 put old Magic Eden Ethereum listings at risk, prompting a whitehat rescue of more than 23,000 NFTs.

articles.title: Bitcoin Rally Slows as $15.6 Billion Options Expiry Hits—XRP and Solana Keep Climbing
articles.description: Pullback or reversal? Here's what the charts suggest for BTC.

articles.title: Strategy Wants Its Preferred Stock Dividends to Accrue 365 Days a Year
articles.description: STRF, STRC, STRK and STRD would accrue dividends on weekends and holidays, in a move Strategy says will dampen volatility.
